parts.zh: M: 现在，让我们来关注一下新闻中较为轻松的一面：在应对食物浪费方面
W: 意大利并不是唯一一个致力于减少食物浪费的国家
M: 在法国，政府已经禁止超市丢弃可食用的食物
W: 尽管还有很多工作要做
M: 这一切可能很快就会改变
W: 那太好了。那条裙子确实很吸引我
M: 我们的裁缝部保证在5个工作日内完成修改

items.stem: What does the woman say about the new laws in Italy?

choices.text: they reward businesses that eliminate food waste.
choices.zh: 它们奖励消除食物浪费的企业。

choices.text: they prohibit the sale of foods that have gone stale.
choices.zh: 它们禁止销售已经变质的食物。

choices.text: they facilitate the donation of unsold foods to the needy.
choices.zh: 它们为向有需要者捐赠未售出食物提供便利。

choices.text: they forbid businesses to produce more foods than needed.
choices.zh: 它们禁止企业生产超过需求量的食物。

items.stem: What did the European Parliament do to reduce food waste?

choices.text: it imposed penalties on businesses that waste food.
choices.zh: 它对浪费食物的企业实施处罚。

choices.text: it passed a law aiming to stop overproduction.
choices.zh: 它通过了一项旨在制止过度生产的法律。

choices.text: it voted against food import from outside Europe.
choices.zh: 它投票反对从欧洲以外进口食物。

choices.text: it prohibited the promotion of bulk food sales.
choices.zh: 它禁止促销散装食品销售。

items.stem: What has the French government done recently?

choices.text: it has warned its people against possible food shortages.
choices.zh: 它警告其民众可能出现食物短缺。

choices.text: it has warned its people against possible food shortages.
choices.zh: 它警告其民众可能出现食物短缺。

choices.text: it has started a nationwide campaign against food waste.
choices.zh: 它发起了一场全国性的反对食物浪费运动。

choices.text: it has banned supermarkets from dumping edible foods.
choices.zh: 它禁止超市倾倒可食用的食物。

items.stem: What is the major cause of food waste in the United States?

choices.text: the confusion over food expiration labels.
choices.zh: 对食品保质期标签的混淆。

choices.text: the surplus resulting from overproduction.
choices.zh: 过度生产造成的剩余。

choices.text: Americans' habit of buying food in bulk.
choices.zh: 美国人批量购买食物的习惯。

choices.text: a lack of regulation on food consumption.
choices.zh: 缺乏对食物消费的监管。

items.stem: What do we learn about Saks department store?

choices.text: it has started a week-long promotion campaign.
choices.zh: 它已经启动了为期一周的促销活动。

choices.text: it has just launched its annual anniversary sales.
choices.zh: 它刚刚推出了年度周年庆销售活动。

choices.text: it offers regular weekend sales all the year round.
choices.zh: 它全年提供定期的周末促销活动。

choices.text: it specializes in the sale of ladies' designer dresses.
choices.zh: 它专营女士名牌服装销售。

items.stem: What does the man say Saks department store offers?

choices.text: price reductions for its frequent customers.
choices.zh: 为常客提供价格优惠。

choices.text: coupons for customers with bulk purchases.
choices.zh: 为大宗采购的顾客提供优惠券。

choices.text: free delivery of purchases for senior customers.
choices.zh: 为老年顾客提供免费送货服务。

choices.text: price adjustments within seven days of purchase.
choices.zh: 购买后七天内进行价格调整。

items.stem: What does the woman want the store to do to address the price difference?

choices.text: Mail a gift card to her.
choices.zh: 给她邮寄一张礼品卡。

choices.text: Allow her to buy on credit.
choices.zh: 允许她赊账购买。

choices.text: Credit it to her account.
choices.zh: 将差额记入她的账户。

choices.text: Give her some coupons.
choices.zh: 给她一些优惠券。

items.stem: What is the service Saks department store offers in addition to the promotion sale?

choices.text: refunding for goods returned.
choices.zh: 退货商品退款。

choices.text: free installing of appliances.
choices.zh: 免费安装电器。

choices.text: prolonged goods warranty.
choices.zh: 延长商品保修期。

choices.text: complimentary tailoring.
choices.zh: 免费修改服装。

items.stem: What do we know about the original Barbie dolls?

choices.text: they are thin, tall, and unlike real human beings.
choices.zh: 它们纤瘦、高挑，不像真实的人类。

choices.text: they have more than twenty different hair textures.
choices.zh: 它们有二十多种不同的头发质地。

choices.text: they have twenty-four different body shapes in total.
choices.zh: 它们总共有二十四种不同的身体形状。

choices.text: they represent people from virtually all walks of life.
choices.zh: 它们代表了几乎所有阶层的人。

items.stem: Why do some people feel unsatisfied with the new Barbie dolls?

choices.text: they do not reflect young girls' aspirations.
choices.zh: 它们没有反映年轻女孩的愿望。

choices.text: they are not sold together with the original.
choices.zh: 它们没有与原版一起出售。

choices.text: their flat feet do not appeal to adolescents.
choices.zh: 它们的平足不吸引青少年。

choices.text: their body shapes have not changed much.
choices.zh: 它们的身体形状没有太大变化。

items.stem: Where will the new Barbie dolls be sold first?

choices.text: in toy stores
choices.zh: 在玩具店

choices.text: in shopping malls.
choices.zh: 在购物中心。

choices.text: on the internet
choices.zh: 在互联网上

choices.text: at Barbie shops
choices.zh: 在芭比专卖店

items.stem: What happened in Germany around the year 1450?

choices.text: moveable metal type began to be used in printing
choices.zh: 活字金属字模开始被用于印刷

choices.text: Chinese printing technology was first introduced
choices.zh: 中国印刷技术首次被引入

choices.text: The earliest known book was published
choices.zh: 已知最早的书籍被出版

choices.text: metal type was imported from Korea
choices.zh: 金属字模从朝鲜进口

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the printer, Plantin of Antwerp?

choices.text: it had more than a hundred printing presses.
choices.zh: 它拥有一百多台印刷机。

choices.text: it was the biggest printer in the 16th century.
choices.zh: 它是16世纪最大的印刷厂。

choices.text: it helped the German people become literate.
choices.zh: 它帮助德国人识字。

choices.text: it produced some 20 million volumes in total
choices.zh: 它总共印制了约两千万册书籍

items.stem: What was the immediate effect of printing?

choices.text: it pushed handwritten books out of circulation.
choices.zh: 它使手抄本退出了流通。

choices.text: it boosted the circulation of popular works.
choices.zh: 它促进了流行作品的传播。

choices.text: it made writing a very profitable career.
choices.zh: 它使写作成为一种非常有利可图的职业。

choices.text: it provided readers with more choices.
choices.zh: 它为读者提供了更多选择。

items.stem: What was the great cultural impact of printing?

choices.text: it accelerated the extinction of the Latin language.
choices.zh: 它加速了拉丁语的消亡。

choices.text: it standardized the publication of grammar books.
choices.zh: 它使语法书的出版标准化。

choices.text: turned translation into a welcome profession.
choices.zh: 它使翻译成为一种受欢迎的职业。

choices.text: it promoted the growth of national languages
choices.zh: 它促进了民族语言的发展

items.stem: What does the speaker say about many college graduates?

choices.text: It promoted the growth of national languages
choices.zh: 它促进了民族语言的发展

choices.text: They spend an average of one year finding a job.
choices.zh: 他们平均花一年时间找工作。

choices.text: They become stuck in the same job for decades.
choices.zh: 他们在同一份工作中困守数十年。

choices.text: They choose a job without thinking it through.
choices.zh: 他们选择工作时没有深思熟虑。

items.stem: What does the Australian website suggest you do first to find a suitable job?

choices.text: see if there will be chances for promotion.
choices.zh: 看看是否会有晋升机会。

choices.text: find out what job choices are available.
choices.zh: 弄清楚有哪些工作选择。

choices.text: watch a film about ways of job hunting.
choices.zh: 观看一部关于求职方法的电影。

choices.text: decide which job is most attractive to you.
choices.zh: 决定哪份工作最吸引你。

items.stem: What should you think about when you look for the right job according to the Australian website?

choices.text: the qualifications you have.
choices.zh: 你拥有的资历。

choices.text: the pay you are going to get.
choices.zh: 你将获得的报酬。

choices.text: the culture of your target company.
choices.zh: 你目标公司的文化。

choices.text: the work environment you will be in.
choices.zh: 你将所处的工作环境。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Kwanzaa?

choices.text: It is as important as Christmas for African-Americans.
choices.zh: 对于非裔美国人来说,它与圣诞节同等重要。

choices.text: It is a cultural festival founded for African-Americans.
choices.zh: 它是为非裔美国人创立的文化节日。

choices.text: It is an ancient festival celebrated by African-Americans.
choices.zh: 它是非裔美国人庆祝的古老节日。

choices.text: It is a religious festival celebrated by African-Americans.
choices.zh: 它是非裔美国人庆祝的宗教节日。

items.stem: For what purpose did Dr. Karenga create the special holiday?

choices.text: to urge African-Americans to do more for society.
choices.zh: 敦促非裔美国人为社会做更多贡献。

choices.text: to call on African-Americans to worship their gods.
choices.zh: 号召非裔美国人崇拜他们的神灵。

choices.text: to help African-Americans to realize their goals.
choices.zh: 帮助非裔美国人实现他们的目标。

choices.text: to remind African-Americans of their sufferings.
choices.zh: 提醒非裔美国人他们遭受的苦难。

items.stem: What does the word "Kwanzaa" mean?

choices.text: faith in self-determination.
choices.zh: 对自我决定的信念。

choices.text: the first fruits of the harvest.
choices.zh: 收获的初果。

choices.text: unity and cooperative economics.
choices.zh: 团结与合作经济。

choices.text: creative work and achievement.
choices.zh: 创造性工作与成就。

items.stem: What do people do while each candle is being lit at the Kwanzaa celebration?

choices.text: they recite a principle.
choices.zh: 他们朗诵一条原则。

choices.text: they take a solemn oath.
choices.zh: 他们进行庄严宣誓。

choices.text: they drink wine from the unity cup.
choices.zh: 他们从团结杯中饮酒。

choices.text: they call out their ancestors' names.
choices.zh: 他们呼唤祖先的名字。

items.stem: What has research concluded about the Mediterranean diet?

choices.text: It is one of the world's most healthy diets.
choices.zh: 它是世界上最健康的饮食之一。

choices.text: It contains large amounts of dairy products.
choices.zh: 它含有大量乳制品。

choices.text: It began to impact the world in recent years.
choices.zh: 它在近年来开始影响世界。

choices.text: It consists mainly of various kinds of seafood.
choices.zh: 它主要由各种海鲜组成。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Seven Countries Study?

choices.text: It involved 13,000 researchers from Asia, Europe and America.
choices.zh: 它涉及来自亚洲、欧洲和美洲的13000名研究人员。

choices.text: It was conducted in seven mid-eastern countries in the 1950s.
choices.zh: 它于20世纪50年代在七个中东国家进行。

choices.text: It is regarded as one of the greatest researches of its kind.
choices.zh: 它被认为是同类研究中最伟大的研究之一。

choices.text: It has drawn the attention of medical doctors the world over.
choices.zh: 它引起了全世界医生的关注。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Mediterranean people from the Seven Countries Study?

choices.text: they care much about their health.
choices.zh: 他们非常关心自己的健康。

choices.text: they eat foods with little fat.
choices.zh: 他们吃脂肪含量很少的食物。

choices.text: they use little oil in cooking.
choices.zh: 他们在烹饪中使用很少的油。

choices.text: they have lower mortality rates.
choices.zh: 他们的死亡率较低。
